cohort: The study included 118 postpartum women who delivered by cesarean section and 94 postpartum women who delivered by normal vaginal parturition.
finding: In the cesarean group, MPV levels significantly increased from the prenatal period (8.60 fl) to the postnatal period (9.10 fl) (p < 0.001), with significant group, time, and group*time interaction effects for MPV.
mod_finding: The study found that MPV increased significantly after cesarean section, suggesting its potential use as a prognostic marker for thrombotic events in patients undergoing cesarean delivery.
